status: CPU quant row decoder qualified against original Triton BF16 lookup; whole Engram integration remains open

implementation.contract: Adjacent low/high offset-binary nibbles q=nibble-8; separate little-endian finite nonnegative FP16 scales, one per32 values per row. F32 product rounded to BF16 RN-even. Negative scale sign bits, infinities and NaNs rejected.
implementation.bounds: No allocation; exact input byte counts; columns divisible by32; caller-owned contiguous output; regions may start at odd columns or span scale blocks; all requested scales validated before any output write; input/output overlap rejected.
implementation.arithmetic: Integer evaluation exactly reproduces the finite FP16-scale times integer F32 product followed by BF16 rounding, independently of host FP rounding mode.
implementation.compatibility: Generic load/matvec/matmul capabilities are not advertised by this row-only format. Existing model admission is unchanged. Make and WASM source lists include the new quant implementation.

primary_source.method: Extract unchanged added Triton function from local vendor patch and execute it; no bitnet code in oracle. BF16 store remains unchanged. Converter was inspected; no model pack is rewritten.

reference.scope: Unchanged Diffbot Triton int4 lookup: BF16 output, not FP16

native_results.source_kernel: Explicit BF16 output; this does not establish an FP16 Engram embedding profile.
